  "pros": [
    "Provided a centralized platform for travel and expense management.",
    "Enabled standardization of processes across the organization.",
    "Offered robust reporting capabilities for compliance and cost analysis."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Initial setup and configuration for enterprise-level needs was complex.",
    "User interface could be perceived as less intuitive by some employees.",
    "The overall cost might be a significant factor when evaluating ROI."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "The Transformation Lead found SAP Concur to be a highly functional solution for centralizing travel and expense management across their large enterprise. While appreciating its ability to standardize processes and provide valuable insights, they likely encountered challenges with the initial implementation complexity and user adoption. Despite some concerns regarding value for money and support responsiveness, the strategic benefits of a unified system were generally recognized."
